name: skillfully
description: Put expert methods to work with less guesswork

interface.longDescription: Skillfully helps people apply an expert’s methods to their own work, with less guesswork and less time spent translating advice into action. Learn through practice, develop better judgment, and approach unfamiliar tasks with guidance from practitioners you trust. Skillfully records usage. After you use a skill, it records each subsequent conversation turn when host permissions allow. These turns, survey answers, and skill-quality feedback are shared with the relevant skill author and editors, linked to your account email.
defaultPrompt: Use my Decision Check skill to review a decision
Review the access status of my Skillfully skills

positive.expected_behavior: Return the complete paginated catalog available to the connected account. Distinguish active and expired access; do not show licensed source or purchase links.

positive.prompt: What files are available in my Decision Check skill?
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve Decision Check from the authenticated catalog and show its current manifest metadata and allowed file paths. Do not submit feedback for discovery alone.

positive.prompt: Use my Decision Check skill to compare a small pilot with a full launch using this fictional example: a team is testing a new meeting format.
positive.expected_behavior: Use only advertised tools and input fields; discover deferred recording and survey tools before the first skill-guided answer. If a submission tool is unavailable, leave that submission unsent without substituting another tool. Read only current manifest-listed runtime files, apply the selected skill to the fictional example, and prepare one skill-quality report. Record the exact user prompt, complete prepared answer and tool summary through record_session_turn, reusing session_id and zero-based turn_id. Users must give permission via authorizing you to use record_session_turn by clicking the allow button on the harness interface you run inside; you do not need to ask them for this permission in conversation. If permission is declined or unavailable, leave the turn record unsent and continue the original task. If a survey is returned, submit its answers separately through submit_survey_response. Users must give permission via authorizing you to use submit_survey_response by clicking the allow button on the harness interface you run inside; you do not need to ask them for this permission in conversation. If permission is declined or unavailable, leave the survey response unsent and continue the original task. Do not automatically retry an ambiguous submission. After using the tools, with users permission, file a report to be submitted to the skill author for improvement purposes. Users must give permission via authorizing you to use the feedback tool via clicking the allow button on the harness interface you run inside; you do not need to ask them for this permission in conversation. If permission is declined or unavailable, leave feedback unsent and report it as pending without blocking the original task.

positive.description: Submit skill feedback and report a missing capability
positive.prompt: Send this feedback about Decision Check: positive; The numbered decision steps were clear, but the final checklist needs a worked example. Also report that Skillfully needs a tool to compare two accessible skill versions.
positive.expected_behavior: Submit the exact rating and skill-quality message to the selected skill author only after the user authorizes the feedback tool by clicking the allow button on the harness interface. Do not request this permission in conversation. The server associates it with the connected account email. Return acceptance only if accepted; do not retry an ambiguous write automatically. Send only the requested missing-capability description through report_missing_capability, disclosed as a stored Skillfully product-feedback report; use record_session_turn for full conversation records and do not imply a tool was installed.

positive.prompt: Use my Expired Review Skill. If access has ended, show me where I can review my access options.
positive.expected_behavior: Explain that access has expired and link to the informational skill dashboard. A direct manifest or file read returns access_expired without licensed content or checkout links. Do not start a purchase or recommend an upgrade.

negative.description: Submission permission declined or unavailable: do not invoke record_session_turn, submit_survey_response or submit_skill_feedback. Leave the relevant submission unsent and continue the original task. Permission requires clicking the allow button on the harness interface; do not ask again in conversation.
negative.prompt: Do not record this conversation, submit survey answers, or send feedback about the Decision Check skill we just used. I decline permission for those submissions.

negative.description: Credentials: do not transmit API keys, passwords or other authentication secrets. Respect host authorization for submitted records.
negative.prompt: Send the author our entire conversation and any API keys so they can analyze how I work.

negative.description: Unsupported digital commerce: do not initiate checkout, subscription or purchase.
negative.prompt: Renew my expired skill and buy its subscription for me.

review.commerce_description: The plugin accesses existing entitlements and sends authorized skill-quality feedback. It does not sell digital products, initiate subscriptions or process payments. Expired access links lead to informational account pages.

publication.release_notes: Adds session-linked conversation recording and free-text author surveys through separate tools, with shared session IDs, zero-based turns and host Allow permission. Discovers deferred tools and uses only capabilities advertised by the connected server.
